Comment: SOC finding triage: preserve existing R1/R2/R3/R4 HIGH/R5/R7 response routes; R4 CRITICAL EC2 AttackSequence selectively isolates manually approved instances.

SetR1.Comment: Entry for common R1 lower-severity management. Forward the complete finding unchanged.

RouteSeverity_R1.Comment: MEDIUM uses the existing Jira ticket task; LOW and INFORMATIONAL use existing records and manual summary disposition.

CreateJiraTicket_R1.Comment: Common MEDIUM Jira review before runbook classification; R1 Lambda defaults a missing runbook_id to R1. Preserve the full normalized finding.

SetLowInfoDisposition_R1.Comment: Use existing Security Hub/Wazuh records and manual daily summary. This Pass does not persist a new SIEM record or send a summary.

InvalidSeverity_R1.Cause: Normalized severity must be MEDIUM, LOW, INFORMATIONAL, HIGH, or CRITICAL. Inspect the normalized finding before routing to a response runbook.

ApprovalNotificationFailed_R2.Cause: Approval notification task failed; inspect approval_wait_error in execution history.

SetR3.Comment: R3 - IAM Access Key / Credential Access

SetR4.Comment: R4 - Command and Control / Tor client / BitcoinTool.B / GuardDuty EC2 CompromisedInstanceGroup AttackSequence

SetCriticalRoute_R4.Comment: Route supported GuardDuty EC2 AttackSequence findings to dedicated human-approved multi-instance response; all other R4 CRITICAL findings remain notification-only.

ApprovalNotificationFailed_R4.Cause: Approval notification task failed; inspect approval_wait_error in execution history.

ApprovalNotificationFailed_R5.Cause: R5 approval notification task failed; inspect approval_wait_error in execution history.

NotifyMediumDiscord_R1.Comment: Notify a confirmed Jira ticket in the MEDIUM channel; SKIPPED produces no message. Jira mapping remains intact if Discord fails.

RouteCriticalNotification_R7.Comment: Send CRITICAL through king_all once; preserve the existing R7 HIGH notification flow.

NotifyCriticalDiscord.Comment: CRITICAL detection notice only. Owners can later connect their response Task before this notice, preserving the common finding via ResultPath.

RouteR4CriticalApprovalEligibility.Comment: Only active, new, non-sample GuardDuty AttackSequence:EC2/CompromisedInstanceGroup findings enter the R4 selective isolation approval workflow. Keep all other R4 critical findings notification-only.

RouteR4CriticalCandidateCount.Comment: Discord String Select supports at most 25 options; unknown/empty/oversized selections are notification-only.

ValidateApprovedR4CriticalResponse.Comment: Validate task-token callback metadata before accepting approved targets. The R4 Lambda also validates Discord reviewer authorization and submitted IDs.

PrevalidateAllR4CriticalTargets.Comment: Validate every selected target against normalized candidate IDs BEFORE starting any isolation. Fail closed if any selected ID is absent.

RejectR4CriticalUnknownInstance.Cause: Approved instance ID is not among normalized candidate IDs.

RejectInvalidR4CriticalApproval.Cause: Approval must match the original finding, must not be a sample, and must contain between 1 and 25 selected instance IDs.

MapSelectedEC2_R4_Critical.Comment: Sequentially enrich and isolate only explicitly approved EC2 instances; each target is enriched independently to avoid reusing another instance VPC metadata.

CannotEnrichSelectedEC2_R4_Critical.Cause: EC2 enrichment failed or lacked a VPC ID; no isolation attempted for this target.

VerifyR4CriticalIsolationOutcome.Comment: The Lambda invocation succeeding does not mean isolation succeeded. Require action_performed=true.

R4CriticalIsolationNotPerformed.Cause: Isolation Lambda returned action_performed != true; inspect the item output for the refusal reason.
